gate: In ReportingTab.tsx the single PerformanceTemplateView mount renders only when the firm id it reads (the scope firm, else the header selection firm) equals '49financial', via a conditional JSX wrapper around the mount near the end of the tab.
words: The Performance tab's one PerformanceTemplateView mount in ReportingTab.tsx now renders only when the firm id the mount reads (the scope firm, else the header selection firm) equals 49financial. A 49 Financial client sees the template. A Cottonwood client does not, because its filled report is not published yet. An Inflection client never sees the template and keeps its PATH A performance. Before this edit the template mounted for every firm, so an Inflection client saw the SYNTHETIC PREVIEW banner and the 49 Financial fixture under its PATH A figures. The edit is 4 lines added and 1 removed. The new test file names the three firms and PATH A; against the base tab it gives 1 pass and 3 fail, and against the gated tab it gives 4 pass. NOT PROVEN: no browser walk, no live render of an Inflection client's PATH A figures (the test asserts its account reads and its tab root, not the figures), and nothing on DEV or PROD. The branch is pushed for Andrew's smoke only.
